capabilities: Embed an animated eyes panel in an Obsidian tab
Track the mouse and text cursor with gaze
Switch between skins and personalities that change expressions
Trigger mood profiles and spontaneous emotions
Tune appearance and reaction settings, including reduced motion
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes a detailed privacy statement claiming no telemetry, no internet use, and no note-text analysis. Manual install instructions cover only manually copying files into .obsidian/plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no playful or entertaining visual widget; the workspace is purely functional with nothing animated or whimsical.
summary: Decorative plugin that embeds animated, reactive googly eyes in an Obsidian tab, with skins, personalities, and mouse tracking.
